cover_note: I have owned a Snowflake migration end to end, coordinating the cutover across data engineering, analytics, and product while keeping warehouse cost under control. That is the shape of the work your Data Platform Program Manager role describes, and it is the part of program management I enjoy most: integrated planning, honest RAID management, and a cutover nobody has to stay up for. At Acme Analytics I ran the analytics roadmap alongside finance and engineering stakeholders, which taught me to translate platform trade-offs into language each group can act on. I would bring the same habits to ExampleCo: a plan the teams actually believe, clear escalation paths, and a migration that lands without surprises.
